description: Read an editable text file from a Discord bot. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Discord bot: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_discord_bots (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: read_discord_bot_file
title: Read Discord Bot File
